relationshipRules: related means shared project lineage or a plausible creative relationship, not proof that one work inspired another.
conversationContext is archival context only; conversation titles are not treated as the artwork files themselves.
Source present means code or a text artifact exists at the linked repository path. It does not mean the piece is deployed, publicly playable, or stored as a rendered image/video.
Unknown authorship, date, asset location, rights, and original media remain unknown rather than being filled by guess.
